messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — my PR #987 (migration guide edits + new SDK snippet) is showing an occasional linkcheck error in the Netlify preview. Build usually passes but linkcheck fails ~1/4 runs. Netlify preview: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1823456789
Chris Wong: can you paste the failing lines? Is it the linkcheck plugin or external redirect 302s?
Maya Patel: looks like this in the preview log:
```
LinkCheck: ERROR https://example-partner.com/old-path -> 404
LinkCheck: WARN https://redirector.example.com/ -> 302 (not followed)
```
Maya Patel: sometimes rerunning the deploy clears it.
deploy-bot: Build finished — preview available: https://deploys.netlify.com/1823456789 (job id: job-pts-9921)
Chris Wong: @Maya can you try `yarn docs:preview` locally and run `npx linkinator` against the generated site? that helps reproduce.
Alex Rivera: Also clearing Netlify cache + re-deploy usually fixes stale redirect rules we've seen. I'm fine with a re-deploy and then merging after confirmation.
Priya Desai: FYI, let's avoid merging during the 10–11am product canary window. If it needs a re-deploy, can we schedule after 6pm PST? :clock6:
Maya Patel: I can re-run the Netlify deploy now with cache cleared. If it still fails I'll run linkinator locally and paste the output.
Maya Patel: re-deploy done: job job-pts-9922 — netlify shows the redirect 302 now followed and linkcheck OK.
deploy-bot: job-pts-9922: LinkCheck: OK, 0 broken links
Chris Wong: awesome — I'll do a quick docs PR review and then we can merge in the evening per Priya
Alex Rivera: For the record, local preview steps:
```
git checkout pr/987
yarn
yarn docs:dev # runs local server on :3000
# or to build static preview
yarn docs:build && npx http-server docs/.vitepress/dist -p 8080
npx linkinator http://localhost:8080 -r
```
Chris Wong: Thanks @Maya — please squash the minor typo fix and ping me when ready, I'll approve and merge after 18:00 PST
Maya Patel: done — squashed, CI passes, going to merge at 18:05 PST. Thanks all :tada:
Priya Desai: :rocket: good run. If we see the linkcheck flake again I'll open a ticket to add a retry step to Netlify pipeline.
Maya Patel: noting that. I'll add a short comment on the PR with the local repro steps and the Netlify job ids for traceability.
merge-bot: (automated) PR #987 merged by Maya Patel
